first_reader_said: NEH 13:13: Both records are Zaccur, son of Mattaniah and father of Hanan the treasurer, with identical family links.

why: NEH 13:13 gives both records the identical identity: Zaccur, son of Mattaniah and father of Hanan. B is a thinner copy of that entry, while A also includes NEH 10:12; the supplied verses show no conflicting parentage, generation, or separate individual.
